entries.605b9a707be6352f: As its basic policy for group management, the company states that in its bus business it will provide safe transportation and passenger services, and in its other businesses it will provide safe and secure products and services, and that it will develop as a corporate group that grows together with and contributes to local communities. Amid continuing route abolitions and service reductions caused by population decline and a shortage of bus crew, the company set up a Management Reform Countermeasures Headquarters in February Reiwa 7, positioned as a second founding, and says it will work to restructure its business foundations and raise corporate value by utilizing the group's management resources and promoting DX. It also says it will work on securing and retaining personnel by reviewing crew wage systems, improving treatment and enhancing human resource development.
